mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which can impair baclofen clearance and increase CNS toxicity risk, while both agents can potentiate neurotoxic effects.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and baclofen levels closely; adjust baclofen dosing based on renal function; correct electrolyte abnormalities; assess for signs of baclofen toxicity (confusion, sedation, weakness).
